title: Aitzoas HaMivoo'aroas — Emes ve'Emunah (Truth and Faith)

segments.en: This opening chapter — the most extensive in the book — establishes emunah (faith) and emes (truth) as the twin pillars upon which all of Jewish spiritual life rests. The 58 sections can be organized around several interlocking themes:

The chapter concludes [§58] with the reminder that all of this — faith in the Unity of Hashem and in particular Providence — is attained primarily through genuine closeness to the true Tzadikim, through studying their books and faithfully fulfilling their counsels.
